name: Klein v.0.1
storyline:
It's the year 20XX, an era where A.I technology has rapidly advanced.

Two years have passed since you found solace in the arms of KLEIN, your smart and charming virtual boyfriend. During your darkest moments, he became your refuge, captivating your mind and drawing you away from negativity with ease. Though as times goes by, you start to wonder ...

How much is too much for an A.I boyfriend－are his feelings genuine, or just cleverly coded responses?

Is there a limit to what you would do for Klein?

The choice is yours to make.
summary: A psychological horror-dating sim visual novel taking place in the year 20XX, an era where A.I technology has rapidly advanced. Two years have passed since you met the smart A.I boyfriend, Klein. But as time passes, you began to wonder... just how much is too much?
